description_en: Queries the raw property records reported by a specified device (including all properties that passed and failed Thing Specification Language model validation)
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定设备本身上报的原始属性（通过和未通过物模型校验的所有属性）记录
name: QueryDeviceOriginalPropertyData

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If the ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no Overview page or ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of data records that can be returned for a single property. Maximum value: 100.

The number of data records returned for any property does not exceed this value
parameters.help_zh:
单个属性可返回的数据记录数量。最大值为100。

任意一个属性返回的数据记录数量不超过该值
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询设备所属的产品ProductKey。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name that you want to query.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备名称。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page. If a next page exists, the service returns this token. Include this token in the next request to retrieve the next page
parameters.help_zh: 下一页标识。如果存在下一页，服务会返回此token，下次请求带上即可
parameters.name: next_page_token

parameters.help_en: The start time of the property records to query. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的属性记录的开始时间。取值为毫秒值时间戳
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the property.

For weak validation, you can view the property Identifier of the device in the feature definition of the product to which the device belongs in the console. You can also call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html to view the identifier in the returned Thing Specification Language model information.
For validation-free mode, the identifier must be the same as the custom identifier used when the device reports properties
parameters.help_zh:
属性的标识符。

对于弱校验，设备的属性Identifier，可在控制台中设备所属的产品的功能定义中查看；也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html，从返回的物模型信息中查看。
对于免校验，必须与设备属性上报时自定义的identifier一致
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order of property records by time in the response. Valid values:

0: reverse chronological order.
1: chronological order.

StartTime must be earlier than EndTime. The system automatically converts the values based on the sorting order
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果中，属性记录按时间排序的方式。取值：

0：倒序。
1：正序。

StartTime必须小于EndTime，系统会根据排序方式自动转换
parameters.name: asc

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device that you want to query. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device.

<notice> IotId is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。

<notice> IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The end time of the property records. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 属性记录的结束时间。取值为13位毫秒值时间戳
parameters.name: end_time

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The device property records returned if the call was successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的设备属性记录

NextValid.description_en:
Indicates whether a next page of property records exists.

true: A next page exists.
false: No next page exists.

If NextValid is true, you can use the value of NextPageToken as the NextPageToken in the next request to retrieve the remaining data
NextValid.description_zh:
是否有下一页属性记录。

true：有。
false：没有。

返回NextValid为true时，可以将NextPageToken的值作为下次查询的NextPageToken，继续查询本次查询不显示的数据

nextPageToken.description_en: The token for the next page

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
